sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Link previews: in a preview window, pointing at a link that opens inside the window (e.g. a label in the LABEL-CAT# column of a release group's versions) no longer makes the value and its column header jump sideways and back. The small ↳ that appeared after such a link on hover is gone: it widened the link and so the whole column. Such links keep their dotted underline, the foot line still says "↳ Opens here", and links that open a new tab keep their ↗.
